Cozy travel set: SPANX AirEssentials® Blanket | Very Black + SPANX AirEssentials® Half Zip | Very Black
Value cozy set: SPANX AirEssentials® Blanket | Storm + SPANX AirEssentials® Half Zip | Truffle Brown

The first feels the most polished and universally giftable. If you want, I can help you choose based on their usual top size. ✨

ckaging is clean and minimal, so it still feels nice to open. If you order both pieces together, it can feel more like a set in your own gift bag or box. ✨

Shipping within the U.S.:

Standard: 5-9 business days total
Basic: 3-4 business days total

turns.replyText:
Can it arrive gift-ready, and how fast can it ship?

Yes, Noah, we can get pretty close to gift-ready. SPANX orders do not come in a formal gift box, but the packaging is clean and minimal, so it still feels nice to open. If you order both pieces together, it can feel more like a set in your own gift bag or box. ✨
